integrity: Exact endpoint-Jacobian proof; independent angular/offset quadratures in included standalone script.
scientific_limitations: No shape-extremal theorem is claimed; full piecewise chord distributions and single-variable boundary primitives are prior literature. Novelty concerns an explicit, side-symmetric case-free fourth moment, and independent historical audit is outstanding.
title: A case-free logarithmic formula for the fourth chord-power integral of every Euclidean triangle
